info.name: OnboardIQ API
info.description:
OnboardIQ backend tests. Before running: `npm run seed` (fresh data) and `npm run docs:files` (writes the .txt files used by the upload requests), then start the server with `npm run dev`.

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner, or `npx newman run`).

item.name: Ex10 A2000010 HIGH risk APPROVE -> PENDING_CHECKER
Officer queue: HIGH first, PAN masked
U1 recommends APPROVE with short comment -> 422
U1 tries to approve as checker -> 403

exec: pm.test("APPROVED with customer id + account number", () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(b.account.customer_id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.account.account_number).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Correct PAN to ZZTPS9012Y -> APPROVE, PENDING_CHECKER

exec: pm.test("APPROVE, no reason codes", () => { pm.expect(b.decision).to.eql("APPROVE"); pm.expect(b.reason_codes).to.eql([]); });
pm.test("document view audited", () => pm.expect(rows.some(r => r.action === "DOCUMENT_VIEWED" && r.doc_id === "D3000025")).to.eql(true));
